status: integrated; 16 real-model diagnostics passed; feasibility/cache-isolation pilot pending
backend: one local Ollama server; actual server version and artifact digest required
native_tokenization: local pinned tokenizer files; render native template with pinned date; normalize leading BOS if backend adds it; count complete prompt including backend BOS before generation
backend_bos_policy: pinned model metadata; planned Llama defaults to backend-added BOS when the field is absent; Qwen explicitly disables it; persist policy and enforce exact backend/native token-count agreement
validation_evidence: runs/phase5-validation-v5/summary.json; 16 successes in a fresh corrected source/run set; prior failures preserved separately
prompt_count_guard: backend prompt_eval_count must equal native rendered-prompt count; discrepancies are failed diagnostics
context: shared BGE reference tokenizer; 1024 tokens including identifiers; exact source offsets
paired_models: identical question, evidence text and instruction; native chat templates may differ
reranker_input: query/passage pairs including special tokens; reject >512; CPU float32; no silent truncation
reranker_order: same initial candidates; descending logits then chunk ID; one context packing pass after reranking

baselines.no_rag: empty evidence context under the same grounding instruction; interpret abstentions accordingly
baselines.gold: SQuAD supporting paragraphs or HotpotQA supporting sentences; source-preserving context budget; separate oracle diagnostic

quality: SQuAD v1.1 and HotpotQA answer normalization; max over reference answers; yes/no/noanswer special rule for HotpotQA
timing: setup offline; fresh online search/fusion then optional reranking, one packing pass and generation; evaluation/serialization after answer receipt
cache_policy: unverified diagnostic only; cached prompt tokens recorded when available; Phase 6 must verify isolation before formal generation measurements
failure_policy: preserve partial output, prompt/context and errors; no automatic retries; use fresh output paths
phase_gate: real questions must succeed on both models, reranker on/off and diagnostic baselines before Phase 5 is marked done
validation_commands: PYTHONPATH=src python -m ragbench_lab answer CONFIG --data-dir DATA --index INDEX --generator-settings PINNED_JSON --native-tokenizer-dir TOKENIZER --output NEW_JSON
PYTHONPATH=src python -m ragbench_lab answer CONFIG --data-dir DATA --generator-settings PINNED_JSON --native-tokenizer-dir TOKENIZER --baseline no_rag --output NEW_JSON
